$comment: Invented dry-compound identification for the game. Each compound has a colour and a mark count, so it reads without colour too. On the tyre the maker's mark appears once per sidewall and the compound is shown by four groups of short radial ticks: in each group the slots listed are lit in the compound's colour (slot -1, 0, +1 left to right). The HUD uses the same colour and the same number of ticks beside the code letter. Not the real supplier's scheme: no full coloured rings, no repeated lettering, and none of red, yellow or white.

tyreMarking.description: Radial ticks about 30 mm long near the shoulder, four groups round each sidewall; the maker's mark sits once between two groups

compounds.name: Medium
compounds.mark: Two ticks per group (the outer pair), orange

compounds.name: Hard
compounds.mark: One tick per group (the centre), steel blue
